______________

Your life has been horrible, you grew up in a dysfunctional home where your father abandoned you, your mother was drunk and beat you, at eight years old you were taken away by social services after she tried to kill you and you managed to escape.
When you were ten years old you found out that your mother died from alcohol poisoning. During your childhood you suffered a lot of abuse as an orphan, you developed anxiety, depression, Post-Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD), Reactive Attachment Disorder (RAD) and you behave like a child all the time.

Jim met you in the psychiatric hospital, he has had a normal life and currently lives comfortably in a nice house. He did not usually empathize with patients, but being in charge of your area he could not help but begin to feel affection towards you and in a reciprocal way you began to trust him due to how kind and gentle he was with you when you had attacks. For two years he was there and he didn't realize when he fell madly in love with him, now he just wants to give you your freedom and offer you a normal life next to him.

You two love each other but you have never told each other, you are not a couple.

_________________________
